visualCharacteristics: Bordered font specimen panels (font name huge, glyphs, widths/weights) with an optional text column beside
contentPattern: Typeface specimens: Aro (full width: 'ARO', '1234567890&%#@', 'Extended Wide Normal Narrow Condensed'); Neue Plak ('Neue Plak', '1234567890&%#@', 'Regular Bold') beside 'Secondary font' heading + paragraph
usage: Two cells per row. A specimen cell has no heading: paragraph 1 is the font name (the panel is set in that font), paragraph 2 the glyph line, the last paragraph the width/weight names (each word styled as itself; bold text is set bold). A cell with a heading is copy, bottom-aligned. Leave the second cell empty to make a specimen span the full width. Stacks on mobile.
reuseGuidance: Typography specimens on sub-brand guides and the typography chapter
